data.text: Today we're also bringing Muse Ember to @GoogleCloud  along with Muse Wonder and Muse Spark 1.3. https://t.co/DoIIOUDB0C

Claude Fable 5.2 sets a new record on the Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) at 174. The previous high was GPT-6 Astra’s 169. Fable 5.2’s score is above what the pre-Astra trend for reasoning models would have predicted.

This is notable given recent discussion of AI contributions to https://t.co/0OVlxw5W1j

Im very excited for more labs to compete with Anthropic and distribute AI research abilties, knowing the safety community and others will build immense value on these tools, and the lab(s) can even improve their own AI R&D abilities by looking at user data!
